question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A perfectionist
solution:
The correct answer is: **Meticulous.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **perfectionist (**पूर्णतावादी) is someone who has a strong inclination or pursuit of perfection, pays great attention to detail, and strives for flawless results. The word "meticulous" accurately captures these qualities.

 
 
• Example: Sarah is a **perfectionist **when it comes to her artwork. She spends hours meticulously refining every brushstroke and ensuring every detail is perfect.
 
 
 
• **Option 2) Omniscient (**सर्वज्ञ) means having complete or unlimited knowledge, which does not align with the meaning of a perfectionist.
 
• **Option 3) Optimist (**आशावादी)** **refers to a person who has a positive outlook and expects favorable outcomes, which is not synonymous with a perfectionist.
 
• **Option 4) Ambidextrous (**उभयहस्त) refers to someone who is able to use both hands equally well, which is unrelated to the characteristics of a perfectionist.
 
• In this context, **option 1) Meticulous** is the most appropriate one-word substitute for the group of words** "A perfectionist"** as it captures the attention to detail and pursuit of flawlessness associated with a perfectionist.
